simple.meaning: גֶּזֶר (gezer) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something cut off ; a portion.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 15:17. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֶּזֶר (H1506) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גֶּזֶר (gezer) / H1506 is traced through Genesis 15:17, Psalms 136:13 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H1506. gezer I. [ גֶּ֫זֶר ] noun [masculine] part , only plural הַגְּזָרִים Gen 15:17 of halves of animals; גְּזָרִים Psa 136:13 of divided portions of Red Sea.
